blurb: Holderness Harbor is a marina on Squam Lake offering boathouse and open slip rentals, valet and dry dock storage, boat detailing, a ship store, marine gas, and boat rentals including pontoon boats, whalers, fishing boats, bow riders, canoes, paddleboards, and kayaks. The marina provides complimentary Wi-Fi, cable TV, and shower facilities. They also assist with 14-day Temporary Boating License testing and NH Boat Registration.
